purpose: Teach: 小早川/クルド/佐渡/サハリン/対馬/府警/カーネル/オナニー

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦国武将小早川秀秋の歴史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered Toyotomi Hideyaki, the Sengoku-period general, in your thesis, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant opening. Gentle confirmation seeking. Patient cadence. The tone of a teacher who's actually read the work and wants to hear him own it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、クルド民族、つまりクルド人の言語社会学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually wrote about Kurdish linguistic sociology and language-community structures.
lines.style: Clear, slightly apologetic correction. Not defensive. A small pause before pivoting. Direct eye contact. The careful precision of someone used to being misheard.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、佐渡金山の鉱山史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered the mining history of the Sado goldfields in your thesis, didn't you?
lines.style: Same gentle confirmation-seeking as before. No edge. Genuinely curious to hear what he'll say this time. Slight tilt of interest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、サハリン、つまり樺太の歴史的境界研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually wrote about Sakhalin's historical border territories and geopolitical boundaries.
lines.style: Same careful correction. Slightly warmer this time—he's settling into the pattern. Steady voice. The tone of someone used to clarifying without resentment.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、対馬海峡の海洋史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered the maritime history of the Tsushima Strait in your thesis, didn't you?
lines.style: Same patient, warm tone. A rhythm is building—she's testing something now, playfully gentle. Slight knowing in the voice, but kind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、府警の組織再編の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually wrote about organizational restructuring in the prefectural police force.
lines.style: Same steady correction. Now there's a hint of wry acceptance in his voice—he knows the pattern. Not rushed. Grounded. The tone of someone learning to be okay with being consistently misunderstood.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、OSのカーネル、つまりカーネル設計の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered OS kernel design—the architecture itself—in your thesis, didn't you?
lines.style: Same warm rhythm. But now there's a glimmer of amusement underneath. She knows something. Not mocking. Genuinely enjoying this. Patient exhale before the question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、思春期のオナニーを巡る発達心理学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually wrote about adolescent development and the psychology of sexual maturation.
lines.style: Final correction lands with quiet firmness. No hesitation now. The faintest hint of defiance underneath—almost relief, actually, to finally say it plainly. Direct. Unflinching but not aggressive.
